note: Edits to the OSM layout for The Aquidneck Club, built into edited/course.geojson by pipeline/merge_edits.py (run by make course). Course chat, 2026-10-31 (developer asleep; the developer's overnight calls: trace carefully, pick-build-flag). Proposals from data/aquidneck/make_proposed.py.

add.reason: Hole 17 Gold (202 yd) has no mapped box: OSM's two boxes are 143 and 153 yd from the green. A raised flat pad (0.45 m above its surround in the 2022 bare-earth DEM) south-east of them, with a mown top and a footpath from the cart path on NAIP, sits about 199 yd from the green centre. Its flat top (30 m2 at the DEM's 1 m cell) grown by 1 m. Traced; listed for the developer's check.

Hole 3 Gold (382 yd) has no mapped box: the hole line starts at the 350-yd box (w915497828). A raised flat pad (0.40 m, 67 m2) west of the cart path behind it, about 372 yd to the green centre. Flat top from the 2022 DEM grown by 1 m. Traced; listed for the developer's check.

OSM maps no driving range, but the course boundary's southern lobe is the practice ground on NAIP (range tee, covered bays, target greens, short-game area, car park). Out of bounds by the standing default: the boundary south of y = 540 m local (35 m south of the 1st tee boxes).

Narragansett Bay, west of 17 and 18: OSM maps it only as a coastline way (fetched as aquidneck_coastline.geojson and merged into raw/overpass.geojson), so it drew as plain ground. Built by pipeline/propose_sea.py; a red penalty area (red_water_osm).

Hole 8 Gold (233 yd): the developer marked the Gold tee in the tracing desk, 2026-10-31 (data/aquidneck/desk/hole08.json, local metres), accepted as marked: a tee box (96 m2) at that mark, golf=tee hole=8 tee_set=Gold tee_pos=centroid (pipeline/desk_to_proposed.py with trace_spec.json desk tee Gold); the game's tee is its centroid. About 212 yd to the green centre (-9 %), accepted by the developer (checks.json).
hole 8's line starts at the centroid of the developer's Gold desk tee (make_proposed.py); OSM's w951590882 started on the Green box. Replaces w951590882.

hole 9's OSM line (w951590893) runs up the fairway's right edge through the woods, so a drive down it hits real trees (course_play centre-line check). Replaced by the same tee and green points with one bend on the main axis of fairway w951590886, 250 yd out, 23 m left of the old line (make_proposed.py).

the clubhouse is mapped golf=clubhouse + building=yes, which s01 reads as a golf feature, not a building (a building=yes tag edit does not change that): copied as a building (as Newport), original dropped. Without it the art drew lidar 'trees' on its roof beside the 18th green.
